problem_type: Semantic generation requires credentials for keyless catalog connections
symptom: Usable local HTTP model is refused with configured_provider in native operation preview.
direct_cause: Bootstrap and submit unconditionally require a nonempty saved API key.
class_root: Semantic executor ignores declared authentication mode.
affected_population: Every enabled published authType none HTTP connection
entry_points: Native MCP generation preview and submit
internal_only_reason: Internal catalog declaration projection, not third-party protocol.
invariants: Keyless connections require a live enabled connection, not invented credentials.
Keyed connections still require valid enabled decryptable credentials.
Unsupported PROCESS and multipart semantic transport remain refused before submission.

door_reduction.why_not: Desktop and stdio each require their own assembly entry, but both call the same live bootstrap and executor.

generality_proof: Declaration-based auth handling spans every keyless HTTP vendor without provider-name branches.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Resolve readiness from declared auth mode and live catalog.
Recheck live connection and declared auth mode at network edge.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Live runtime factory calls shared bootstrap.
Same live factory for stdio MCP.

recurrence.reason: Every imported graph can hit unknown or colliding model identity on each projection.
same_class_scan: Independent review traced renderer, handbook and planner; native refusal reproduced.

prevention.invariant: Keyless connections require a live enabled connection, not invented credentials.
prevention.failure_mode: Missing or disabled live connection rejects, and any keyed auth still requires nonempty key.
prevention.strategy: Use catalog authentication declaration consistently at readiness and network edge.

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove unconditional key requirement only for explicit authType none; preserve all keyed-auth and unsupported-transport checks.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No dependency determines internal metadata projection.

migration: No persisted data changes or fake credentials. Read live auth declaration.
residual_risks: Codex PROCESS execution remains on existing canvas transport, not this HTTP-only executor.
